newsitem.title: NORWAY: Deutsche, MGAM clarify Norway holdings.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche, MGAM clarify Norway holdings.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG and Morgan Grenfell Asset Management Limited (MGAM) said on Tuesday they had sold on client instruction some shares in Norway's international software house Sysdeco.
"A total of 558,759 shares in Sysdeco Group ASA have recently been sold on the instructions of a client of an MGAM group company," the two companies said in a joint statement to the Oslo bourse.

This brought the stake under MGAM management to 4,115,396, or about 20.7 percent of Sysdeco's issued share capital, the two said, adding that they did not think the holdings needed to be consolidated under Norwegian law.
"As previously announced, it should be noted that Deutsche Bank is separately and indirectly interested in approximately 26.7 percent of the issued share capital of Sysdeco," the statement said.

The Morgan Grenfell European Growth Trust and the Morgan Grenfell European Capital Growth Fund each hold 535,891 shares in Industri investor ASA, each representing approximately 4.8 percent of its issued share capital, the two said.

Portfolios managed by an MGAM group company on behalf of clients also include holdings of 75,000 and 51,000 shares in investment group Industri investor, representing about 0.7 and 0.5 percent respectively, the statement said.

Eight investment funds managed by MGAM group companies hold a total of 7,358,591 shares in offshore equipment group Hitec ASA, together representing about 22.1 percent of the issued share capital of Hitec, the statement said.
